_comment: CHURN CARD — D5 v5 ARM.  One functional key over _ft63_churn_base.json:
network.carry_invariant_innov_carried_only.  Neither v3's corroborate nor v4's
retap_only is armed here — all three act on the same population and arming more than
one per arm makes the A/B unreadable.
WHAT IT DOES.  The gate no longer evaluates a chord that was BORN this epoch.  The
test is |v| > k*sigma0*sqrt(Cov(v)) with Cov(v) the H0 covariance about the CARRIED
prior; a fresh chord's prior is the diffuse fresh-chord variance, so the ratio is not
a hypothesis test at all.  Its 'reset' is a no-op — a diffuse chord's posterior
ALREADY is the data-only tap-off — and the flag's only lasting effect is the funnel
entry that re-borns the chord next epoch, where it flags again.
WHY THIS IS THE ROOT ARM.  Measured on runs/churn_base (this arm's own baseline,
3 h, 63 sta, DOY-129) with the new algebra columns: 32 062 of 33 628 flags — 95.3% —
sit on born chords at EXACTLY sqrt(var_v) = 1000.000 m, the diffuse prior, with a
median |v| of 19.2 km (an x_lin-frame distance, not a physical DD disagreement).  27
chords are born-flagged on more than half of all flagged epochs; URUM00CHN/G22 runs at
duty 0.99.  A chord re-born every epoch has by construction never accumulated
anything, which is precisely why dd_sigma_cyc cannot leave its pin and med|frac_cyc|
stays uniform at 0.25.  v3 and v4 suppress this same population for INCIDENTAL
reasons (a born chord's arc usually reads measured-and-flat); v5 removes it at the
source, and it is the one of the three that is defensible as a correctness fix rather
than a policy: D5 v2 already excluded born chords from the sigma0 accumulator for this
exact reason and simply never applied the same exclusion to the DECISION.
WATCH: a run-end born-skipped count of 0 means no born chord ever reached the gate —
INERT, not benign (standing invariant #4).
